info.title: Aimeos Store API
info.description: REST API for Aimeos storefront. Covers authentication, user profile, cart management, checkout flow (address → shipping → payment → process), seller KYC/KTP verification, seller product management, and admin tools. Authorize using a Bearer token obtained from login/register.

tags.name: Checkout
tags.description: Multi-step checkout flow: address → shipping → payment → process (requires auth)

tags.name: Order History
tags.description: Customer order history and details (requires auth)

tags.name: Seller
tags.description: Seller profile and product management (requires seller role)

tags.name: Admin
tags.description: Admin tools for seller KYC verification (requires admin role)

post.description: Register a new Customer account on the default site. Returns a Sanctum authentication token.
Register a new Seller account. The seller will be in **pending** status until an admin approves their KTP (identity document). Returns a Sanctum authentication token.
Register a new Administrator account on the default site.
Authenticate user credentials and issue a Sanctum Bearer token.

get.description: Get a list of all finished/pending orders for the authenticated customer. Does not include active shopping carts.
Get complete details of a specific order belonging to the authenticated customer, including the `payment_url`.

post.description: Submit a complaint or return request for a specific order. You can upload proof (photo/image).

patch.description: Seller or admin can provide a resolution to an existing order complaint.

resolution.example: Kami akan mengirimkan barang pengganti besok.

404.description: Complaint not found for this order.

get.description: Browse all active products. No authentication required.
Get a single product by Aimeos product ID.
Get all approved reviews for a specific product.

post.description: Submit a rating and comment for a product after ordering. Optionally upload a photo.

get.description: Returns the current user's shopping cart including all products.

post.description: Add a product to the cart. Maximum total quantity per cart is 99 items.

400.description: Product not found or stock unavailable.

delete.description: Remove all products from the cart.

get.description: Get all saved addresses from the authenticated user's address book.

post.description: Add a new address to the user's address book.

get.description: Get all products saved in the user's wishlist.

post.description: Add a new product to the user's wishlist.

422.description: Validation error or product already in wishlist.

post.description: Select an address from the user's address book to be used as the delivery and billing address for checkout. The address must be added first via `POST /api/user/addresses`.

address_id.description: ID of the address from the user's address book

403.description: Address does not belong to the current user.

get.description: Retrieve available shipping methods with estimated costs. Currently returns mock/dummy options.

post.description: Select a shipping method for the current order. The selected shipping data is saved directly to the database.

400.description: Cart is empty or invalid shipping code.

get.description: Retrieve available payment methods. Currently returns mock/dummy options (will be connected to Midtrans).

post.description: Select a payment method for the current order. The selected payment data is saved directly to the database.

400.description: Cart is empty or invalid payment code.

post.description: Finalize the checkout. Validates that address, shipping, and payment have been selected. Changes order status to **pending** and returns a mock Midtrans payment URL. Prerequisites: cart must have products, delivery address must be set, shipping method must be selected, payment method must be selected.
Allows a seller whose KTP was **rejected** to upload a new KTP image. The seller status will be reset to **pending** for re-review by an admin. Requires `seller` role. Accepts `multipart/form-data`.

200.description: KTP uploaded, status reset to pending.

message.example: KTP berhasil diunggah ulang. Menunggu verifikasi admin.

400.description: KTP was not previously rejected (can only re-upload after rejection).

get.description: Get all products belonging to the authenticated seller. Requires `seller` role with **approved** KYC status.

post.description: Create a new product listing. Requires `seller` role with **approved** KYC status.

404.description: Product not found or does not belong to seller.
Product not found or does not belong to seller.
Product not found or does not belong to seller.

get.description: Get all sellers with **pending** KYC status awaiting admin review. Requires `admin` role.

post.description: Approve a seller's KTP/KYC submission. The seller's status changes to **approved** and they can start listing products. A notification will be sent to the seller. Requires `admin` role.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Laravel User ID of the seller

post.description: Reject a seller's KTP/KYC submission. The seller's status changes to **rejected** and they can re-upload a new KTP via `POST /api/seller/reupload-ktp`. A notification will be sent to the seller. Requires `admin` role.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Laravel User ID of the seller

ktp_image.description: URL of the seller's uploaded KTP image

message.example: The email has already been taken.

email: The email has already been taken.
